reuse.why: Changes the existing shared getScheduleAmount, which every worst-case consumer (forecast, schedule actions, posting, preview, API) already calls, and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The rule is edited in its single definition; no new copies are introduced.

placement.why: The rule lives in #shared/schedules where the tree already defines it; call sites only get comment updates.

scope.why: Only the helper body, its tests and the now-stale comments at call sites are touched.

maintainability.why: Math.min and value - tolerance express 'lowest allowed value' directly and simpler than before.
